{{Top|leg}}
'''Gate 3''' was a terminal at the [[Tomorrowland Starport]] as well as [[Spaceport THX1138]]. The latter location had at least one subgate for departures: Gate 3D.

[[Egroeg Sacul]] was asked to see a Star Tours agent at gate three before departing on a [[Endor Express|trip to Endor]].
